answer: Each agent locks 70 credits, files a grove census return per epoch for a plot. A plume stamp binds return to key, plot, epoch. Returns hash onto the last, so the spiral trail exposes copies and the auditor burns bonds filed twice. K-th filing 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-census ring fails: a rented return carries its owner's key, burning both. Honest agents file once, pay 38, keep their bond.
